title: Version DAO receive persistence as DRX2
description: Change scope-bound DAO receive high-water magic to provisional DRX2 and document DTX2/DRX2 as unshipped scope-bound formats, with no migration or fabricated scope.
acceptance_criteria: Old records fail closed explicitly; DRX2 round-trips scope and high-water; comments/docs identify provisional scope-bound format version.
close_reason: DRX2 receive high-water verified as provisional scope-bound format, fail-closed end to end. Slot: DRX2 magic|slot version 1|generation u64|len u32|payload|CRC32 over redundant rpl.rx.a/b; payload: node(16)|instance(1)|DODAGID(16)|count u16|entries of key(32)+seq u64 BE+sha256(32). Magic/version enforced in hal parse_slot: DRX1/DTX2/garbage/short/unversioned records open as DaoPersistentOpenError::Corrupt, absent as Missing, no migration or fabricated scope by design; scope rebinding (node/instance/DODAGID) rejected as ScopeMismatch in DaoManager::open_root. Module doc now names DTX2/DRX2/DAD1 provisional unshipped scope-bound formats with no cross-version migration. Evidence: 9 new tests in lichen-rpl/src/persistence.rs (roundtrip bit-exact, storage roundtrip via open_root, old/wrong magic, unversioned, garbage/short, malformed payload, scope change, missing) all pass; cargo test -p lichen-rpl 218 lib + 47 integration pass; clippy -p lichen-rpl --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt -p lichen-rpl -- --check clean.
